entities.name: Liparit IV, Duke of Kldekari
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Liparit IV, sometimes known as Liparit III, was an 11th-century Georgian general and political figure who was at times the most valuable support of King Bagrat IV of Georgia (1027–1072) and his most dangerous rival. He was of the House of Liparitid-Baguashi, and thus, a hereditary duke (eristavi) of Kldekari and Trialeti.
